title: agent.run ops rows carry no exit, so a failed worker run is always an ok span
goal: an agent.run ops row records whether the run failed, so kbmon --events gives its kb.agent.run span the status error and the OTLP trace shows a failed worker run in error

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import ql_capture;sys.exit(0 if "exit" in ql_capture.OPS_EVENTS["agent.run"] else 1)

gates.question: What marks a subagent run as failed in its agent.run row, when SubagentStop carries no status field?
options: exit 1 when the closing text opens with API Error, else 0
no exit: leave the span ok until Claude Code documents a status
gates.recommendation: exit 1 when the closing text opens with API Error, else 0
gates.answer: exit 1 when the closing text opens with API Error, else 0
